feedback: The faculty are very knowledgeable and explain difficult concepts clearly. Best teaching I have had so far.
Wi-Fi is extremely slow in the hostel and keeps disconnecting during online submissions.
The computer lab has outdated systems and many computers are not working. We cannot complete practicals on time.
The library has an excellent collection of books and a quiet comfortable reading room.
Canteen food is overpriced and the hygiene is poor. Found it unhygienic multiple times.
Exam results were delayed by over a month and the evaluation process felt unfair.
The administrative office is unhelpful and the fee payment process involves too much paperwork.
Classrooms are clean and spacious with working projectors. Great infrastructure overall.
Our professor is always available for doubts and gives helpful feedback on assignments.
Internet connectivity in the library is unreliable which makes research very difficult.
The placement cell organised excellent training sessions and mock interviews. Very helpful.
The lab is well maintained and the lab instructors are supportive.
Question papers were too lengthy and did not match the syllabus covered in class.
Canteen has a good variety of healthy snacks and the staff is friendly.
The placement cell rarely updates students about upcoming company visits. Communication is poor.
Library timings are too short during exam season. Please extend the hours.
Some teachers just read slides and do not interact with students. Lectures feel boring.
Hostel rooms are overcrowded and the washrooms are not cleaned regularly.
The college Wi-Fi works well in the main building and is fast enough for video lectures.
Administration staff resolved my scholarship issue quickly and politely.
The sports ground is well maintained and the college organises great events.
Sports facilities are limited; we need more equipment for cricket and badminton.
Practical sessions in the physics lab are well organised and the experiments are relevant.
The exam schedule was announced too late which gave us very little time to prepare. Stressful.
Parking space is insufficient and the campus roads are in bad condition.
The mentoring programme helped me a lot; my faculty mentor guided me through my project.
Average experience overall. Nothing special but nothing terrible either.
Classes start on time and the attendance system works fine.
Placement training should start from the second year and not just the final year.
The sports complex stays closed after 6 pm so we cannot use it after classes.
